updates.text: Implemented crash‑ and concurrency‑safe cache writes, atomic graph caching, and a prepare‑only training mode for the SAT solver selection tool.
The game now counted spills, displayed taunts, and rendered moving walls, fake walls, and moving goals.
Started spillway: a 2D fluid puzzle game in C++20 that uses a from‑scratch position‑based SPH simulation to let players draw walls and guide water into a goal.
Rewrite the options hedging engine in C++20.
Rewrite the Monte Carlo engine in C++20.
Rebuilt pitwall as a race engineering tool on real F1 data, added themed radio player and single‑lap pit windows, and fixed pit loss calculations and data publishing.
Redesign the web app as a story editor.
Started arc-length-of-xn: a paper on how fast the arc length of y = xⁿ approaches 2, with LaTeX source and a verification script.
